title: Disclosure of Representation
text: In BC, a real estate licensee should provide the Disclosure of Representation in Trading Services form at the earliest reasonable opportunity so consumers understand client and non-client relationships.

title: Agency Duties under RESA
text: Brokerages and licensees owe clients duties of loyalty, confidentiality, avoiding conflicts of interest, and full disclosure under the Real Estate Services Act.

title: Multiple Representation Basics
text: When multiple representation arises, additional disclosures and informed consent are required, and limits may apply to what advice can be provided to each client.
